questions.question: Which message does the Charge Point send to report a status change or error, and which side receives it?
questions.ground_truth: StatusNotification.req, sent by the Charge Point to the Central System

questions.question: Which fields are required in BootNotification.req?
questions.ground_truth: chargePointModel, chargePointVendor

questions.question: Which field is required in Authorize.req?
questions.ground_truth: idTag

questions.question: Which fields are required in StartTransaction.req?
questions.ground_truth: connectorId, idTag, meterStart, timestamp

questions.question: Which fields are required in StopTransaction.req?
questions.ground_truth: meterStop, timestamp, transactionId

questions.question: Which fields are required in MeterValues.req?
questions.ground_truth: connectorId, meterValue

questions.question: What ChargePointStatus values can be reported for the Charge Point main controller (connectorId = 0)?
questions.ground_truth: Available, Unavailable, Faulted

questions.question: What are the allowed values of Reason in StopTransaction.req?
questions.ground_truth: DeAuthorized, EmergencyStop, EVDisconnected, HardReset, Local, Other, PowerLoss, Reboot, Remote, SoftReset, UnlockCommand

questions.question: What does connectorId 0 designate in MeterValues.req, despite the stated connectorId > 0 constraint?
questions.ground_truth: The main powermeter; the same field definition also states connectorId > 0

questions.question: What does the HeartbeatInterval configuration key control?
questions.ground_truth: The interval of inactivity after which the Charge Point should send a Heartbeat.req

questions.question: Which field is required in RemoteStopTransaction.req?
questions.ground_truth: transactionId

questions.question: What are the allowed RegistrationStatus values returned in BootNotification.conf?
questions.ground_truth: Accepted, Pending, Rejected

questions.question: What fields are exchanged in the BootNotification request and response?
questions.ground_truth: BootNotification.req requires chargePointModel and chargePointVendor; BootNotification.conf contains currentTime, interval and status.

questions.question: What fields does StartTransaction.req contain, and when must the Charge Point send it?
questions.ground_truth: It contains required connectorId, idTag, meterStart and timestamp plus optional reservationId; the Charge Point SHALL send it to inform the Central System that a transaction has started.

questions.question: What fields does StopTransaction.req contain, and when must the Charge Point send it?
questions.ground_truth: It contains required meterStop, timestamp and transactionId plus optional idTag, reason and transactionData; the Charge Point SHALL send it when a transaction is stopped.

questions.question: How is the Reason field of StopTransaction.req defined, and what should it be assumed to mean when a transaction ends normally?
questions.ground_truth: Reason is optional and MAY only be omitted when it is Local; for normal termination, an omitted Reason SHOULD be assumed to be Local.

questions.question: What does MeterValues.req carry, and how does the specification define the periodic sampling that produces it?
questions.ground_truth: meterValue carries the sampled meter values and connectorId identifies the connector; MeterValueSampleInterval defines the sampling interval and MeterValuesSampledData defines which measurands are included.

questions.question: What does connectorId 0 mean in StatusNotification.req, and which ChargePointStatus values may the main controller report?
questions.ground_truth: connectorId 0 identifies the Charge Point main controller, which may report only Available, Unavailable or Faulted.

questions.question: What exact timeout, in seconds, does OCPP 1.6 mandate for the Central System to respond to Authorize.req?
questions.ground_truth: Not specified in OCPP 1.6 Edition 2.

questions.question: What exact timeout, in seconds, does OCPP 1.6 mandate for the Central System to respond to BootNotification.req?
questions.ground_truth: Not specified in OCPP 1.6 Edition 2.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of simultaneous transactions that OCPP 1.6 permits a Charge Point to have?
questions.ground_truth: No numeric maximum is specified in OCPP 1.6 Edition 2.

questions.question: What does RemoteStartTransaction.req contain, and what does the response status mean?
questions.ground_truth: The request requires idTag and may contain connectorId and chargingProfile; the response status is Accepted or Rejected, indicating whether the command will be executed.

questions.question: What fields does ReserveNow.req contain, and what are their cardinalities?
questions.ground_truth: connectorId (required), expiryDate (required), idTag (required), parentIdTag (optional), reservationId (required).

questions.question: What does Reset.req contain, and what does its required type field specify?
questions.ground_truth: Reset.req contains the required type field, which specifies whether the Charge Point should perform a Hard or Soft reset.

questions.question: What fields does StopTransaction.req contain, and what are their cardinalities?
questions.ground_truth: idTag (optional), meterStop (required), timestamp (required), transactionId (required), reason (optional), transactionData (optional).

questions.question: What fields does StatusNotification.req contain, and what are their cardinalities?
questions.ground_truth: connectorId (required), errorCode (required), info (optional), status (required), timestamp (optional), vendorId (optional), vendorErrorCode (optional).

questions.question: If the Central System never responds at all to a transaction-related message, what exact behavior must the Charge Point follow?
questions.ground_truth: The document does not specify the required behavior; it states that what constitutes a failure to respond is defined in the OCPP JSON Specification and OCPP SOAP Specification.
questions.notes: The corpus also contains the OCPP-J spec, so retrieval may surface an answer from there.

questions.question: If the Central System never responds to a non-transaction-related message, what exact timeout and retry behavior does OCPP 1.6 mandate?
questions.ground_truth: No exact timeout and retry behavior is specified in OCPP 1.6 Edition 2.
